modules.html:
Modern, reliable, and natural-looking dental crowns

Dental crowns offer an exceptional solution that restores the appearance of your teeth and enhances their functionality and strength. With a diverse range of benefits, dental crowns have become an essential tool for achieving both cosmetic and functional improvements.

Dr. Nour Amin, Dr. Mustafa Shinta, and the rest of our Montrose dental crowns team are uniquely equipped to provide you with the best possible crown placement experience.
Benefits of our dental crowns

Protects damaged teeth

Crowns reinforce weak, cracked, or heavily restored teeth, offering long-lasting protection and preventing further damage.

Natural appearance

Each crown is custom-crafted to your exact tooth shade, shape, and bite — for a seamless, natural-looking result.

Long-lasting durability

With proper home care and regular cleanings, your crown can last for many years, providing reliable support you’ll barely notice.

Improves functionality

Enjoy comfortable chewing, speaking, and smiling again. Crowns restore balance to your bite and confidence to your daily routine.
Answers to your questions about dental crowns

items.title: Do I need sedation to get a dental crown?
items.html: Most patients don’t need sedation; local anesthesia is usually all you’ll require to stay completely comfortable. If you experience dental anxiety, we can discuss gentle sedation options to help you feel at ease during your Montrose dental crowns treatment.

items.title: I have a damaged crown. Can you help?
items.html: Absolutely. Whether your crown is loose, cracked, or has fallen out, we’ll evaluate the damage and determine whether it can be rebonded or replaced. Our crowns are designed for longevity and an ideal fit.

items.title: Will insurance cover the cost of a dental crown?
items.html: Many plans provide partial or full coverage for crowns. Our team is happy to review your benefits and explain your out-of-pocket costs.

items.title: What should I do to take care of my dental crown?
items.html: Brush and floss daily, stay on top of cleanings, and protect your gums, since gum disease is the leading cause of preventable tooth loss. With good care, your crown will remain strong for years.

modules.html:
What it’s like getting a crown

  • Tooth preparation: We gently prepare the tooth to ensure a stable foundation for your new crown.
  • Digital 3D scanning: No messy impressions — our digital scanner captures highly accurate images for a perfect fit.
  • Custom crafting: Your scan is sent to a trusted local dental lab, where your crown is beautifully designed to match your smile.
  • Final placement: In about two weeks, we bond your crown securely, adjust your bite, and make sure everything feels just right.
  • Natural & durable: Your crown is strong, biocompatible, and virtually invisible — built to blend beautifully and last for years.
